Description: Susceptible humans become exposed to the virus through bites from infectious mosquitoes.
A fraction of exposed individuals progress to the asymptomatic infectious class after a latent period.
A fraction of exposed individuals progress to the symptomatic infectious class after a latent period.

Name: β_h(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts.

Name: γ_1(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: γ_2(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: μ_h
Description: The natural death rate of human hosts.

Name: β_v(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes.

Name: μ_v
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.
